cues.text:
I tried to build a life alone
And make my strength a cornerstone

But all the things I called my own
Could never give my heart a home

You met me with a love so deep
And gave the life I could not keep

Now by Your grace, my heart is free
The life I live is Christ in me

Alive in You, alive in You
Your grace has made this heart anew

No longer living on my own
Jesus, You make my heart Your home

In every word and all I do
Let others see the love of You

My life is Yours, my heart is free
Alive in You, Christ lives in me

When someone needs a helping hand
Lord, teach me how to understand

When pride would turn my heart away
Let mercy shape the words I say

Like branches rooted in the vine
The strength to love is Yours, not mine

In little things that others see
Let Your own life bear fruit in me

Alive in You, alive in You
Your grace has made this heart anew

No longer living on my own
Jesus, You make my heart Your home

In every word and all I do
Let others see the love of You
My life is Yours, my heart is free
Alive in You, Christ lives in me

With You I died, with You I rise
To walk by faith, with open eyes

You loved me first and gave Your life
Now teach me how to live in Christ

Alive in You, alive in You
Your grace has made this heart anew

No longer living on my own
Jesus, You make my heart Your home

In every word and all I do
Let others see the love of You

My life is Yours, my heart is free
Alive in You, Christ lives in me

Alive in You, Christ lives in me
